sourceNote: Evidence extracted directly from uploaded CAPS PDFs. Only FET (Grades 10-12) Mathematics contains an explicit, document-stated percentage weighting table for assessment purposes. Intermediate Phase (4-6) and Senior Phase (7-9) documents were inspected and do not contain an equivalent explicit percentage-per-paper assessment weighting table; they contain teaching-time allocations (hours/week, weeks-per-topic) which are CURRICULUM_CONTENT_WEIGHTING, not EXPLICIT_CAPS_WEIGHTING, and must not be used as assessment mark allocation without further teacher confirmation.
